# Intake

Roles:

- Business Analyst
- Reviewer

When Boss gives a request, Captain shall prompt Business Analyst:

> Write the requirements the request implies, one per line.

When the requirements are written, Captain shall prompt Reviewer:

> Review the requirements and list numbered findings.
